records.source_meaning: Angelo asks to speak with the admiral.
records.whole_exchange_context: Angelo asks the whole crew to hear the truth: his only family, Bianca, died of illness three years ago. Unable to accept it, he convinced himself she was missing and searched the world. Recalling his own fever collapse, he reports her telling him that his companions are now family and that he should live for himself. The scene does not establish a living Bianca or explain whether the encounter was a dream or vision. Xien and Maria encourage him to live for her too and explicitly embrace the crew-as-family bond. His final private promise moves from apology to determination. Addressing Xien as an old man does not establish kinship.

イヤホウ！

records.source_meaning: Jam exuberantly reacts to Calicut's expected heat.
records.whole_exchange_context: In hot Calicut, impulsive Jam pursues street food and loses a ten-heads coin-toss wager to Samwell, promising to obey him. Maria suspects the coin; it proves to be two coins stacked with heads on both sides. Samwell turns exposure into a bid to travel with the fleet, claiming he can do anything. Jam wants to work him hard and is drawn into pleading alongside him. Maria admires the ingenuity that outmaneuvered Jam and accepts, while Xien remains skeptical. Samwell mentions boredom with elephants and a first sea voyage; do not invent an elephant-related job, real slavery, money loss, supernatural luck or training/stat outcomes. Richard and Yukihisa comments are alternatives. Keep Jam's rough energy, Samwell's childlike cunning and Maria's dry confidence distinct.
